AtlasReasons.MTF_SUPPORTS_SHORT: Multi-timeframe analysis supports a short position.

AtlasReasons.PRICE_ACTION_BULLISH_STRUCTURE: Price action shows higher highs and higher lows.
AtlasReasons.PRICE_ACTION_BEARISH_STRUCTURE: Price action shows lower highs and lower lows.
AtlasReasons.PRICE_ACTION_RANGING: Price action is ranging or structurally mixed.
AtlasReasons.PRICE_ACTION_BULLISH_BOS: A bullish break of structure is confirmed.
AtlasReasons.PRICE_ACTION_BEARISH_BOS: A bearish break of structure is confirmed.

AtlasReasons.LIQUIDITY_BEARISH_SWEEP: A bearish liquidity sweep is confirmed above liquidity.

AtlasReasons.VOLUME_BULLISH_PRESSURE: Volume analysis confirms bullish buying pressure.
